level1.description: The warrior provokes an enemy into attacking them instead of their allies.
level1.name: Taunt

level1.description: The warrior slams an enemy with their shield, with a chance to stun.
level1.name: Shield Bash

level10.description: The warrior delivers a stunning slam that leaves the enemy reeling.
level10.name: Slam

level20.description: The warrior refuses to fall, fighting on through wounds that would kill lesser mortals.
level20.name: Last Stand

level5.description: The warrior strikes twice in rapid succession with their weapon.
level5.name: Double Attack

description.lore: Warriors stand on the front lines of every battle in Norrath, shield raised and blade ready. Through rigorous training and unbreakable resolve, they master every weapon of war and endure blows that would fell lesser mortals. When a warrior holds the line, allies fight with confidence.
description.summary: Warriors are masters of melee combat, unmatched in resilience and martial prowess.
